name: 回合回溯 / Turn Rewind
author: Yummn
description: Adds a mobile-friendly turn rewind bar to every combat. Up to 10 player-turn snapshots are kept in FIFO order. Long-press a snapshot segment to restore that turn; dragging the bar moves the whole panel and never selects a turn. No BaseLib dependency. The v0.1.31 build rebinds restored power creature references by CombatId and repairs Sandpit targets before the next turn callback.
